items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: And I told him that I wanted to hear Tony and he take me out one night to hear Tony Jackson.

ctx.x: Well where was Tony Jackson playing in Chicago? Do you remember?

He was playing in the Deluxe Café upstairs. And Red (P) (O) (Batiste) because he knew Tony, and he knew I wanted to hear Tony. And Red (P) (O) (Batiste), he worked for the NapolitW brothers. They called it the Little Club in New Orleans. And I told him that I wanted to hear Tony and he take me out one night to hear Tony Jackson. Boy I was so proud and he played such beautiful piano you know. Not jazz, it wasn't jazz.
